changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE topic_rating ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, topic_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, score TINYINT NOT NULL COMMENT '1..5', created_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_rating (user_id, topic_id), KEY idx_rating_topic (topic_id) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT = '地点评分';
